paper.title: Chained Information-Theoretic bounds and Tight Regret Rate for Linear Bandit Problems

settings.name_in_paper: Bandit problems with smooth rewards on a metric action space (Bayesian)
unmapped: Compact action set in a metric space (A, rho)
Rewards form a separable subgaussian process w.r.t. rho for every environment parameter (smooth rewards)
settings.definition_quote: We say that the rewards are \emph{smooth on the metric space $(\cA,\rho)$}, if for all environment parameters $\theta \in \cO$, the random rewards $\{R(a,\theta)\}_{a\in \cA}$ form a separable subgaussian process on $(\cA,\rho)$.

settings.name_in_paper: d-dimensional linear bandit with smooth rewards (Bayesian)
unmapped: Rewards form a separable subgaussian process w.r.t. a metric rho on the action set (smooth rewards)
settings.definition_quote: a $d$-dimensional linear bandit problem is a bandit problem with $\cA,\cO \subset \bR^d$ and such that for all $a\in \cA$ and all $\theta \in \cO$ we have $\bE[R(a,\theta)] = \innerproduct{a}{\theta}$

settings.name_in_paper: d-dimensional linear bandit with smooth rewards w.r.t. ||.||_2 and action set in the unit ball (Bayesian)
unmapped: Rewards form a separable subgaussian process w.r.t. the Euclidean metric on the action set: log E exp(lambda(R_a-R_b)) <= lambda^2 ||a-b||^2/2
settings.definition_quote: For $d$-dimensional linear bandits with smooth rewards with respect to $(\cA,||.||_2)$ and a ball-structured action space $\cA\subseteq \overline{\mathbf{B}_d(0,1)}$

symbols.Gamma_bar_k: upper bound on the expected k-th chain-link information ratio E[Gamma_{t,k}]
symbols.H_k: entropy H(A*_k) of the k-th quantization (2^{-k}-net) of the optimal action

conditions: rewards smooth (separable subgaussian process) on (A, rho)

source.label: thm:main_theorem
source.quote: For bandit problems with smooth rewards on the metric space $(\cA,\rho)$, the \emph{2-TS} expected cumulative regret after $T$ steps is bounded as \REG^{\textnormal{2-TS}}_T \leq \sum_{k=k_0+1}^\infty \sqrt{ 2\cdot \bar{\Gamma}_k \cdot T  \cdot \ent(A^\star_k) }, where $A^\star_k$ is the $k^\textnormal{th}$-quantization about the optimal action ...

results.notes: Bayesian regret defined against the per-parameter optimal action A* = psi*(Theta). The algorithm does not use T, so horizon recorded as anytime (T assumed even). Action space generic metric space mapped to continuum_other.

symbols.H_k: entropy H(A*_k) of the k-th quantization of the optimal action

source.label: thm:smooth_linear_bandit
source.quote: For $d$-dimensional linear bandit problems with smooth rewards on the metric space $(\cA,\rho)$, the \emph{2-TS} expected cumulative regret after $T$ steps is bounded by \REG^{\textnormal{2-TS}}_T &\leq 12 \sum_{k=k_0+1}^\infty 2^{-k}\sqrt{ d \cdot T  \cdot \ent(A^\star_k) }

results.notes: Combines Theorem 1 with the chain-link information ratio bound Gamma_{t,k} <= 2(6*2^{-k})^2 d.

symbols.J_ent: entropy integral int_0^infty sqrt(log N(A, rho, eps)) d eps of the action set

source.label: cor:entropy_integral
source.quote: For a linear bandit of dimension $d$, with smooth rewards on the metric space $(\cA,\rho)$, the \emph{2-TS} expected cumulative regret after $T$ steps is bounded as \REG^{\textnormal{2-TS}}_T \leq 24 \sqrt{d \cdot T} \int_{0}^\infty \sqrt{ \log(|\cN(\cA,\rho,\varepsilon)|) } d\varepsilon

results.notes: Depends only on the action set geometry, hence recorded as worst_case over priors.

conditions: action set contained in the closed Euclidean unit ball and compact

source.label: prop:linear_smooth_bandit_unit_ball
source.quote: For $d$-dimensional linear bandits with smooth rewards with respect to $(\cA,||.||_2)$ and a ball-structured action space $\cA\subseteq \overline{\mathbf{B}_d(0,1)}$, where $\overline{\mathbf{B}_d(0,1)}$ is the $d$-dimensional closed Euclidean unit ball, the \emph{2-TS} expected cumulative regret is bounded as \REG^{\textnormal{2-TS}} \leq 7\cdot d  \sqrt{T}.

results.notes: Proof uses alpha^{-k}-nets with alpha=20, constant ≈6.27 rounded to 7.
